definitions.explanation: To cause something closed to become open. A transitive verb - you open something. The intransitive pair is {開|あ}く (aku).

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}けて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}けて⟦みて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Please try opening the gift box. What do you think is inside?

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}けて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れたい→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's hot, so may I open the window? There's no air conditioner, so I want to let in the breeze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}けました。⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていました→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I used a key to open the drawer. There were old photographs inside.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pair: ⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧ (intransitive, to open by itself). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}ける.

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {開|あ}けている usually means 'have opened (and it's still open)' rather than 'is opening.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}ける (open the window)
・⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}ける (open the door)
・⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}ける (open one's mouth)
・⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}ける (make a hole)

Opposite: ⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ (to close something).

CONFUSABLE: {開|あ}ける vs ⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧, which are written with the same kanji but are not interchangeable. Use {開|あ}ける for things that swing, slide, or come apart to leave a gap: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧, ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧, lids, and containers. Use ⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ for things that unfold or spread out, and for holding an event: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (open a book) is standard, while ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|あ}ける is not said.

cross_references.label: to open (unfold, spread); to hold (an event)
